items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had a guy named Bert – no, not Bert Ryan. I’ll think of his name. The guy that invented hi-fi. Bert Porter.

ctx.x: Yeah. Then came Skin Deep. The history of Skin Deep: I told you I wrote that when I was with Tommy’s band in 1948, put it in a drawer, forgot about it. I took it back out when Duke said, “Have you got a drum vehicle?” I said, “Yeah, I do have.” During those years, it was hard to record drum beats – especially fast beats – and make them clear. Duke was a little leery about going into the studio to do that. We were playing one- nighters up around Fresno. We played in a wonderful old ballroom – one of those old-…
